# Peel Ports Group new multi-million-pound investment in new warehousing for critical UK industries

07 October 2026

The UK's second-largest port operator will create more than one million square feet of additional Grade A warehousing capacity across its network, helping customers secure access to critical storage space at a time when demand continues to outpace supply. 

According to a July report by Savills, there is increasing demand for larger warehousing across the country meaning the UK could be facing a major shortage, creating growing pressure on available capacity and increasing the importance of strategically positioned logistics infrastructure. 

Against this backdrop, Peel Ports is investing to ensure customers have access to the storage facilities they need to maintain resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. 

The phased programme will deliver one million square feet of new warehousing space, equivalent to approximately 92,000 square metres or around 13 football pitches.

Oct. 8, 2026

The new facility represents the latest step in Walmart’s transformation of its supply chain, bringing associates together with advanced automation, technology and machine learning to move products faster and more efficiently. ## LTL carrier’s North American terminal count reaches 300 

 Todd Maiden 

· Thursday, October 01, 2026 

 XPO expanded its North American footprint to 300 terminals following the addition of new service centers in Missouri and Arizona. (Photo: Jim Allen/FreightWaves) 

Less-than-truckload carrier XPO announced Thursday that it has added new locations in Arizona and Missouri, increasing its terminal count to 300 across North America.

A new 51,000-square-foot facility in Mesa, Arizona has 86 dock doors and over 100 employees. The terminal gives XPO (NYSE: XPO) needed capacity to serve the Phoenix market, where it already operates a freight assembly center. The region is experiencing an increase in demand given recent industrial investments and growing cross-border trade with Mexico.

A 13,000-square-foot terminal in Cameron, Missouri (approximately 50 miles north of Kansas City) has 32 dock doors and over 30 employees. It sits near the intersection of I-35 and U.S. 36, serving both north-south and east-west freight corridors.

# Wagner Logistics Leases 830,000 Square Feet in Liberty, Vows 79 New Jobs

By Priya Farrell

Published on October 14, 2026

2320 S. Withers Rd. — Wagner Logistics’ New Operation Site Google Street View

Wagner Logistics has signed a multi-year agreement with an unnamed Kansas City-area manufacturer, launching a new warehouse operation in Liberty, Missouri that spans more than 830,000 square feet across two leased facilities and is expected to add 79 jobs over the next two years. The work starts immediately, and once fully operational, the site will run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

According to real estate market reporting by Newmark Zimmer, Wagner secured the footprint by leasing the entire 516,550-square-foot Liberty Commerce Center Building II from NorthPoint Development, plus 317,150 square feet in Building B of the Liberty Heartland Logistics Center from The Opus Group. The jobs figure comes from the Kansas City Area Development Council, which said the program is expected to add the 79 positions over the next two years. results.title: Al Sharqi Shipping inaugurates AED 70mln multi-temperature integrated logistics and distribution hub at Dubai Industrial City | ZAWYA
results.text:
Al Sharqi Shipping inaugurates AED 70mln multi-temperature integrated logistics and distribution hub at Dubai Industrial City | ZAWYA
## Spanning 280,000 sq. ft. of built-up storage area and 200,000 sq. ft. of open yard space, the new facility will cater to domestic demand and strengthen the regional supply chains
Press Release
• Investment expected to create 500 new jobs and will support F&B, FMCG, retail, manufacturing, and quick-commerce sectors, among others
**Dubai, UAE**: Al Sharqi Shipping, a leading UAE-based logistics service provider, has inaugurated its new integrated logistics and distribution hub at Dubai Industrial City, part of TECOM Group PJSC.
The newly launched facility represents an investment of AED 70 million and will serve customers across food and beverage, Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), retail, hotels, restaurants, and cafés (HoReCa), quick-commerce, and manufacturing industries. It will cater to domestic demand while enhancing Al Sharqi Shipping’s regional distribution capabilities.
The new facility has a total built-up storage area of 280,000 sq. ft., 200,000 sq. ft. of open yard space, 30,000 sq. ft. of office space and a 40,000 sq. ft. basement area.
